user.title: Connect to Canvas LMS
user.description:
Enter your Canvas instance URL and Personal Access Token.

To generate an Access Token:
1. In Canvas Global Navigation, click **Account** and then **Settings**.
2. Under **Approved Integrations**, click **+ New Access Token**.
3. Enter a Purpose (e.g., `Home Assistant`) and click **Generate Token**.
4. Copy the generated token and paste it below.

data_description.base_url: The web address of your school's Canvas instance (e.g., school.instructure.com or canvas.university.edu).
data_description.access_token: Personal access token generated in Canvas under Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Canvas LMS
reauth_confirm.description:
The existing access token is invalid or expired. Please enter a valid access token.

To generate a new Access Token in Canvas, go to **Account** > **Settings** > **Approved Integrations** > **+ New Access Token**.

data_description.access_token: Personal access token generated in Canvas under Account > Settings > Approved Integrations > + New Access Token.

init.title: Canvas LMS Options
init.description: How long to wait for Canvas to show work the student marked "I submitted it", how early quizzes and tests show up to study for, and which grades to flag.

data_description.online_grace_hours: Online submissions usually appear in Canvas within minutes. Default 12 hours.
data_description.paper_grace_days: Paper work only appears once the teacher enters a grade. Default 7 days.
data_description.quiz_lead_days: Quizzes appear in the assessments list this many days before they happen. Default 3.
data_description.test_lead_days: Tests appear in the assessments list this many days before they happen. Default 7.
data_description.escalation_threshold: Grades below this percentage are flagged for attention. Default 80 (a C or lower).

set_assignment_stage.name: Set assignment stage
set_assignment_stage.description: Set the student's own stage, note and/or kind on a Canvas assignment. This never marks the assignment complete; only Canvas can.

config_entry_id.name: Canvas account
config_entry_id.description: The Canvas integration entry. Optional when only one Canvas account is set up.

assignment_id.name: Assignment ID
assignment_id.description: The Canvas assignment ID (the to-do item's uid).

student_id.name: Student ID
student_id.description: The Canvas student (observee) id. Only needed when two students share the assignment; the card sends it automatically.

stage.name: Stage
stage.description: Where the student says the work is. Homework uses not started, working, done and submitted; quizzes and tests use not started, studying, ready and needs make-up.

note.name: Note
note.description: Plain text, up to 500 characters. Leave out to keep the current note; send an empty value to clear it.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Correct whether this is homework, a quiz or a test. Automatic goes back to the integration's own classification.

set_followup_stage.name: Set follow-up stage
set_followup_stage.description: Update a teacher follow-up: its stage, how the teacher was contacted, and a note.

config_entry_id.name: Canvas account
config_entry_id.description: The Canvas integration entry. Optional when only one Canvas account is set up.

followup_id.name: Follow-up ID
followup_id.description: The follow-up id: student ID, assignment ID and reason, e.g. 6021:5506356:late_work.

stage.name: Stage
stage.description: Progress on the follow-up. Resolved records the time; any other stage clears it.

method.name: Method
method.description: How the teacher was contacted. Send an empty value to clear it.

note.name: Note
note.description: Plain text, up to 500 characters. Leave out to keep the current note; send an empty value to clear it.

review_assignment.name: Review grade
review_assignment.description: Mark a graded assignment reviewed by the student or a parent. The Home Assistant user who calls it is recorded.

config_entry_id.name: Canvas account
config_entry_id.description: The Canvas integration entry. Optional when only one Canvas account is set up.

assignment_id.name: Assignment ID
assignment_id.description: The Canvas assignment ID (the to-do item's uid).

student_id.name: Student ID
student_id.description: The Canvas student (observee) id. Only needed when two students share the assignment; the card sends it automatically.

role.name: Role
role.description: Who is reviewing: the student first, then a parent. Default student. Parent review needs an administrator account.

undo.name: Undo
undo.description: Clear the review instead. Undoing the student's review also clears the parent's.

close_assignment.name: Close without grade
close_assignment.description: Stop waiting on the teacher for work that won't get a grade. A grade that arrives later reopens it for review.
